recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless the work group reopens the broader workflow classification of HealthcareService.
issue_request: FHIR-12850 requested removing HealthCareService from the workflow definition pattern because it describes an available service instance rather than defining a type of service.
initial_application: The Jira comment records SVN#12374. Git-svn commit 5064224bd079b7f4ef4023d3ead9111b57bd8bff applied workflow-related tracker items and removed HealthcareService from source/workflow.html's Definitions list.
additional_context: The current workflow page's Definitions list omits HealthcareService, while HealthcareService remains an active resource in source/fhir.ini. Its current introduction describes an organization/location service and role use in request/event patterns, consistent with not classifying it as a definition resource. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scope source already reflects the requested removal and no authoritative source location found in the bounded review still places HealthcareService in the definition pattern.
